comment: Fighter contrast scan (#528): a live bot match runs while client/qa/contrast_scan.gd reads fighters 10 to 40 m apart from each other's eyes and measures each against its local background. Run per map: LOCALEXCEPTION_QA_SCRIPT=res://qa/contrast_scan.gd LOCALEXCEPTION_QA_MANIFEST=res://qa/contrast-scan.json LOCALEXCEPTION_QA_MAP=<1..8> LOCALEXCEPTION_QA_BOTS=9 LOCALEXCEPTION_QA_SEED=1 tools/qa_tour.sh <out>.
